title: Prove all-depth attainment of 4g-3 destination channels (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped written mathematical proof with exact finite corroboration. For every g>=3, one explicit cut in the balanced dirty word on n=2^g-1 free factors has exactly 4g-3 completed-leaf destination channels of mass g-1. With PR5938's cited upper bound, this settles its first open question and proves E_k(2^g-1)=k(g-1) for 1<=k<=4g-3.

```text
root phase path V', V', U, then g-3 copies of V
read scratch level three
(2g-3) U channels + (2g-3) U' channels + 3 inverse-pair channels
    = 4g-3 maximum-mass channels
```

The new contribution is the recursive injecting-leaf family, common cut and all-depth attainment proof. Credit Nick Petalas's #5938 for the upper bound and question; Philippe Van Velzen's #2177 for the model, complete-call, exit, readout and inverse lemmas; Chafik Boukhalfa's #628 and the retained error-transport lineage. Predecessor claims are cited, not audited or replayed as the result. This contribution was produced by Nick Petalas. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Evidence

Before: #5938 proved the all-depth upper bound and checked attainment only at g=3..6; #2177 reported a g=7 census. After: PROOF.md supplies an explicit attaining family for every g>=3, with a closed cut position t_g=(43*4^(g-2)+2)/3-3*2^(g-1).

Local CPython 3.12.15, standard library only:

- Warning-strict isolated normal and optimized runs pass, in 2.87 and 2.75 seconds respectively, each below its 120-second registered timeout.
- At g=3..9, all 147 selected channel polynomials agree between backward-row and separate forward-column propagation, containing 847 signed monomials in each direction. Every injecting leaf at each specified cut is scanned. Literal readout rows, cut positions, total word lengths and phase counts agree with their formulas.
- Six invalid-depth/duplicate-injection rejections and five semantic controls pass. Normal and optimized generated hash-bound receipts are identical.
- Registered metadata/pin checks and both registered replays pass. Committed-byte and source-history preflight passes at fe9695186ab5bc60cfee1ca156c09f0fede40493. A read-only seven-file standalone export, replayed outside the repository with a path containing spaces, gives the same receipt.

Reproduce from the repository root; another CPython 3.12 path may replace this local interpreter:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -X dev -W error -B research/all-ones-channel-attainment/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -X dev -W error -O -B research/all-ones-channel-attainment/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/all-ones-channel-attainment
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/all-ones-channel-attainment --check-source-history
```

Expected markers: PASS_ALL_ONES_CHANNEL_ATTAINMENT, PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE and PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES. Receipts are computed from executed checks and file hashes; no handwritten receipt is committed.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

This is a free-algebra channel-mass theorem for distinct completed-leaf error symbols, not simultaneous numerical attainment under one fixed contraction assignment. The all-depth statement rests on the written proof and cited predecessor premises, with finite executable corroboration through g=9. Lower mass levels, E_infinity, correlated or internally rounded errors, production reachability, physical precision/access/storage, native/compiler/stock/tape/analytic obligations and supplier admission remain outside scope. No new kappa or selected-frontier change. No selected cold replay, Lean, Docker, independent human or proof-kernel review was run.

## Open next questions

- Determine the next E_k segment after k=4g-3. First derive the mass-(g-2) histogram at this cut, then prove a matching comparison over every cut. That global comparison is open.
- Bind a production precision contract to the independent completed-leaf error model. First establish actual reachable states and rounding correlations; the complete physical precision invoice remains payable.

## Related open work

Completion refresh considered all twelve other account open PRs created since the advance CLAIM at 2026-11-03T15:55:54Z. None studies completed-leaf destination-channel counts in this balanced word, and no conflicting common value was found. No additional computations checked their results. Merged #2177 and #5938 remain cited predecessors. Live open/account PRs, recent handoffs, merged general-form searches and main README formula/object searches were checked before publication; unpublished work and arbitrary diffs remain outside coverage.

## CI notes

Hosted CI has not certified this package at commit `fe9695186ab5bc60cfee1ca156c09f0fede40493`. In [run 41670552412](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41670552412), the `plan` job was cancelled at `actions/checkout` by the 10-minute job timeout. The job started at 2026-11-03T16:05:23Z and was cancelled at 16:15:28Z. Setup-python and every later repository step were skipped, so package selection and the package replay never ran. This is an infrastructure failure before any repository check executed. The local checks and reproduction evidence above remain unchanged.

The checks were read once with `gh pr checks 6668 --repo CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds`, which reports `plan` failed after 10m5s and replay skipped. The job-step record confirms checkout was cancelled and the later steps were skipped. Among the twelve most recent registered-package workflow runs inspected, the other completed runs succeeded; the remaining runs were still in progress. No matching checkout cancellation was confirmed in those completed comparison runs.

## Merge Danger

Door: two-way. Blast Radius: isolated. Only the new research/all-ones-channel-attainment package is added; no shared implementation, frozen evidence or selected record changes.
